# JSZip 3.10.1

LipoScope vendors the minified browser build from the official `jszip@3.10.1` npm package and embeds it in each distributed HTML application.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/jszip/v/3.10.1
- Vendored bundle: `jszip.min.js`
- Bundle SHA-256: `acc7e41455a80765b5fd9c7ee1b8078a6d160bbbca455aeae854de65c947d59e`
